purpose: Teach: 水害/カラフル/陰陽/大連/一眼/絹/敷居/ベーコン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが水害支援のボランティアに行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been volunteering with disaster relief lately, hasn't he.
lines.style: Warm observation, gently paced. A little wistful on the opening. Soft voice, like she's thinking out loud while looking at him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、カラフルなクレヨンで絵描いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew a picture with all these colorful crayons.
lines.style: Bright and immediate, eager to share. Natural child's pace, slightly fast. A small proud lift on the last word, looking for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが陰陽五行のご本を持ってるのよ
lines.en: Sho, did you know Mei-sis has a book about yin and yang and the five elements at home?
lines.style: Gentle invitation to curiosity. Slight smile in the voice. Unhurried, like she's offering him something she thinks he might like.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、社会で大連の歴史やったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, we studied about Dalian's history in social studies.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but trying to connect. Child's earnestness — he's offering her something he found interesting, wanting her to care about what he learned.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが一眼カメラで翔くんを撮って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad took the most wonderful photograph of you with his camera the other day.
lines.style: Tender warmth. Slight pause after the opening to let the image land. Genuinely pleased — she's noticing something good about his father and him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの絹のスカーフ大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Grandma's silk scarf so much.
lines.style: Soft sincerity, no pretense. A simple statement of genuine affection. Quiet conviction — not asking for validation, just sharing what's true.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお家の敷居が低くて入りやすいわね
lines.en: Sho, it's nice isn't it — how easy it is to step into Mei-sis's home.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. A moment of quiet gratitude. Slow, warm, like she's noticing the feeling as she speaks it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ベーコンが好きだよ
lines.style: Simple declaration, matter-of-fact with a slight warm edge. A small child's directness — stating something true without needing it to build to anything.
